description: poweroff command actually powers the machine off (M6.5). Typing `poweroff` in the kernel terminal calls crate::power::poweroff(), which pulls the emulator ACPI soft-off ports; QEMU exits during the settle window so the FAILED marker never prints. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_poweroff_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 30 --timeout 180 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: the poweroff command reached the power mechanism

forbidden.why: the machine did not actually power off — the ACPI soft-off ports were not honoured
